text:
Leave the curls of gold that hold my soul entwined, and return to untrodden snow the white tinged by those roses.

Leave the pearls and precious coral adorning that mouth, and return to envious heaven the suns you stole from it.

Return the grace and discretion shown by the heavenly Master's great wisdom to angelic nature;

and all this restored, you will see what remains truly yours: to be harsh, cruel, ungrateful, and hard.

translation.title: Leave the Curls of Gold
